name: LuckyNode
author: Lucky Node

sections.description:
LuckyNode is a multi-functional WordPress plugin designed to improve your website’s capabilities.

Key Features:

  • Performance

    • Image optimization to reduce file sizes and boost load times.
      • WebP & Avif conversion support for images.
      • Automatically convert new images to desired format:
        • Convert to Avif (recommended)
        • Convert to WebP
        • Do not convert
        • Do not convert, but optimize (coming soon)
      • Compare conversion/optimization result
      • Bulk convert/optimize all images at one go
      • Bulk convert/optimize in the background (coming soon)
    • Database optimization for reducing bloat and speeding up queries. (coming soon)

  • CRM

    • Find companies and their websites automatically for outreach.
    • Create your own contact list for email marketing campaigns.
    • Create email message campaigns to deliver your message to inboxes of your contacts.
    • More features coming soon.

  • AI Content & Image Creation

    • Effortlessly create pages & blog posts with AI assistance. (coming soon)
    • Never need to try & search images for your pages/posts anymore. (coming soon)

  • More Features Coming Soon

    • We are planning to bring more awesome features to LuckyNode
    • Our purpose will be to eventually become only plugin you would need while working with WordPress
sections.installation:
1. Install the LuckyNode plugin by searching for “luckynode” in your website’s WP-admin dashboard under Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin by going to Plugins > Installed Plugin menu inside your WP-admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
How do I enable image optimization?

After activating the plugin, go to the Performance tab and select Image Optimization to adjust the settings and start optimizing your images.
